posts.text: Thank you to @WednesfieldCFC for the visit, lovely bunch and great addition to the @nwcfl safe journey home folks.
3 points https://t.co/AsCyJwlppB

Sub for the Bach,

Hamnett on for Barry
Cain goes in the book, not sure why possibly in an attempt to run the clock down.
Sub for the bach Williams for Bevan, but the sub falls foul of the new rule and is not conducted in time, Bach down to ten men for a minute.
The 90 is up but with a hydration break we have 7 added
Freekick for the opposition well struck misses the wall but Greg Hall is up to the task with a diving save to deny.
Its a well worked almost goal for the Bach as Bevan drives into the box finds Barry who slots home but is agonisingly ruled offside.
Another sub for the Bach on 82’ Foley off, Cain on another like for like sub

Sub for the Bach

Kieran Nolan off, Tatters on. 

another like for like swap.
A lovely diag ball finds Foley a first touch and good control could have set him up nicely but the ground was cruel and made it hard to control
O'Connell with a shot from distance hits the side netting
Another chance for the Bach as Foley heads it off the back of his head and finds Bevan who shoots but miss hits it and it trickles wide.
Sub for the Ramblers Shotton replaced by Finney like for like swap.

The second half started scrappy, but the deadlock is broken on 51' mins as Hatton loops a ball with a flick from the outside of the foot to Bevan who heads over the defender rounds him picks up the ball and switches feet twice before slotting home to the right of the keeper.
2-1 https://t.co/UYe5sjSZox
All square at half time despite Sandbach having the majority of the play. https://t.co/naAC1VyqBo

42' and Wednesfield equalise after the keeper kicks out and a bit of a luck leg is stuck out and somehow it hits it and it deflets into the sandbach goal from the edge of the box. That was pretty freak !!

1-1
How have we not scored another, dominant in possession confident. This time Shotton overlaps down the wing and crosses to Barry who heads it just over again.
Barry breaks through I thouoght he was going to shoot, but he elects to place it directly across goal onto Foleys head it is agonisingly close and just clears the bar. great play and a good chance.
Free kick is cleared with a header, came to nothing. Mainly Sandbach in the game. The pitch is dry and bouncy which makes it interesting.
O'Connell drives towards the box is fouled and rolls into the box, free kick just outside for the Bach
The first of many we hope. https://t.co/VzQRE2BLor
15' another dangerous corner form the Bach as Mitch Nolan delivers it deep and finds Hatton who heads over.

Take a look at the programme for todays game.

1-0

FT here and the Ramblers deserved winners finishing 6th and just one point from the playoffs. A disappointing season where we look back at the missed opportunities and points, regroup and plan for 2026/27
4 mins added and Mikulski weaves and turns in the box unleashing a fierce shot but its wide of the post.
A good game from Thiam today, but that is it for now as he is subbed off for Mikulski

Sandbach with a second, a beautiful finish from Thiam who simply thunders it into the top of the net. The keeper had no chance. 

2-0
Great clearance from Hatton who appears from thin air to nick it off the feet of the Ashville 8 who was prepping a shot.

Couple of Sandbach subs

Ford on for Birchall
Cope on for Pollard
Pollard and Foley are having a great game so far 👏🏻
Sandbach applying a lot of pressure now pollard and foley link up well but can’t find a shot. Ibu is being strong and causing defenders trouble and Birchall is lurking just awaiting the spilt ball.

51’ Foley drives 30 yards weaves through three players has the option to pass wide or shoot, shoots it moves in the air on target and forces a great save over the bar. 

Moments later the Ramblers get another chance as Birchall shoots but it’s wide
A chance for Ashville a sweet delivery into the box finds Cahill who heads it wide. Maybe should have done better.

The corner is deftly taken and a shot from a yard is blocked the ball clears and lands at Birchalls feet who shoots it’s cleared of the line and Oconnell is quick to react and put it home.

1-0
Foley with a deep cross finds O’Connell who head a lofty one toward the goal it teases as the goal keeper tops it over for a corner
Handbags as Courtnell dives to the floor for the third time. Fair play to the ref who dealt with it well and dishes out 3 yellow. Thiam picks up the yellow for Sandbach.
A annoyed delight of a ball through the middle from pollard puts foley through with just the onrushing keeper. Didn’t quite get there in time and the keeper clears.
First clean shot for Ashville but easily saved by Ello low down.
Ashville with the majority of play as the seek to win and overhaul a huge GD to reach the playoffs albeit a vague dream for them. Sandbach defending well and just managing themselves into the game.
